ignore.reason: Affected code is not built or shipped: RTSP demuxer and muxer (ff_rtsp_connect's redirect loop in libavformat/rtsp.c, compiled only for the RTSP demuxer/muxer and SDP demuxer; the build has --disable-network and only the file protocol). Verified against the pinned source, CI configure output and exact bundled libraries.

Affected code is not shipped: CVE-2025-5222 is in the genrb resource compiler (tools/genrb/parse.cpp and SRBRoot), not the ICU runtime libraries. The exact image contains only libicudata/libicui18n/libicuuc; genrb and libicutu are absent. Upstream already fixed this in 2c667e31cfd0b6bb1923627a932fd3453a5bac77; no new upstream patch is needed.

Affected code is not built or shipped: HarfBuzz's experimental WebAssembly shaper (hb-wasm-api/hb-wasm-shape, WAMR). Qt 6.12.0's bundled HarfBuzz compiles neither file and does not define HAVE_WASM; verified against the Qt source, the official binary's configuration and the exact libQt6Gui.so.6.

Compiled but not reached: fts5MergeRowidLists in SQLite's FTS5. Qt 6.12.0's driver compiles FTS5, but put.gd creates no FTS tables, loads no extensions, attaches no databases and opens only its own private history.sqlite. Reaching this code takes a replaced history file, which already means code running as the user. Verified against put.gd's source, the Qt source and the exact libqsqlite.so; no Qt release carries SQLite 3.54.
